messages.content: What is the largest planet in the universe?

function.name: space_star_info

message.content:
The largest planet that astronomers have confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5–3 times that of Jupiter** (about 0.25 R☉). This makes it one of the biggest gas‑giant planets ever found.  

There may well be even larger planets out there—especially around very massive stars—but none have been definitively measured yet.
